### Summary
What is delivered and why (1–3 sentences).

### Validation

### Testing checklist
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated for changed managed behaviour (`Testing/SAM.OCCT.UnitTests`).
- [ ] Integration tests added/updated when native OCCT behaviour changes (`Testing/SAM.OCCT.IntegrationTests`).
- [ ] New `.cs` files carry the SPDX header from `COPYRIGHT_HEADER.txt`.
